evidence_quotes: Not a single texture, 3d model, or mp3 in this video.
just ONE html file(644kb) and pure math.
built with antigravity + Gemini 4 NEON /swarm.
15,867 3d feather plumes (111k barbs) in custom glsl
three.js refractive glass, god rays & macro bokeh
web audio api synthesizing every chirp, wingbeat & room reverb in real time
A zero-asset, interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single self-contained HTML file (`index.html`).
skills_or_prompts_used: 复杂几何实例化与程序生成
交互式摄像机控制设计
summary: 一个完全零资源的交互式3D鸟类宏观观察体验，封装在单一HTML文件中。世界内含超过15867根实例化的3D曲线多瓣羽毛，每根羽毛由多达111069个细小羽支组成，层叠于16层天鹅绒般的绒毛底层，呈现无缝圆润轮廓。环境包括金色阳光照射下有晶莹的雪覆盖的庭院、折射的玻璃温室、樱花盛开、体积光和飘雪效果。支持无碰撞穿越开启的天窗飞行，有缓慢多角度宏观镜头轨道、锐利的景深散景效果。音效由Web Audio API实时合成，包括鸟鸣、翅膀拍打及温室混响。完全由Three.js、自定义GLSL和Web Audio API通过纯数学程序生成，无任何外部模型、贴图或音频文件。
summary_en: A fully zero-asset interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single HTML file. It features over 15,867 instanced 3D curved multi-barb feather plumes (111,069 individual barbs) layered over 16 velvety down undercoat shells forming a seamless round silhouette. The environment includes a golden-hour snowy yard, refractive glass greenhouse, blooming sakura, volumetric sunbeams, and exterior falling snow. The bird autonomously flies collision-free through an open skylight with slow multi-angle macro camera orbits and sharp macro depth of field bokeh. Real-time procedural audio synthesis generates bird trills, wing beats, and greenhouse reverb. Everything is procedurally generated by Three.js, custom GLSL shaders, and Web Audio API from pure mathematics with no external 3D models, textures or audio files.
title: Shima Enaga 3D
workflow_steps: 设计多瓣羽毛实例和绒毛底层的程序算法
编写自定义GLSL羽毛渲染着色器，包含高光和次表面散射
程序生成雪地、折射玻璃温室、樱花、体积光和雪花效果环境
实现鸟类自主飞行状态机和无碰撞天窗穿越路由
搭建多通道WebGL2渲染流水线，支持折射、深度纹理、泛光和宏景深后处理
用Web Audio API实时合成鸟鸣、翅膀声、环境声和混响
集成摄像机控制与隐藏控制面板提供多功能开关
打包为单文件HTML，无任何外部依赖
workflow_steps_en: Design procedural algorithm for instanced multi-barb feather plumes and smooth down undercoat
Develop custom GLSL shaders for feather rendering with specular and subsurface effects
Create procedural environment with snowy terrain, refractive glass greenhouse, sakura blossoms, sunbeams, and snow particles
Implement autonomous bird flight state machine with collision-free routing through skylight opening
Set up multi-pass WebGL2 rendering pipeline for refraction, depth textures, bloom, and macro depth of field postprocessing
Synthesize real-time procedural bird chirps, wing beats, ambient soundscape, and convolution reverb with Web Audio API
Integrate camera controls and hidden control panel with various toggles
Package entire experience into a single self-contained HTML file with no external dependencies

evidence_quotes: Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the cloud against DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on two DGX Sparks: same voxel-world prompt, one try each.
Sonnet built Skyhaven in my Claude Code CLI.
The Sparks run @MiaAI_lab's 2-Spark recipe (EXL3 2.9 bpw on TensorFold, commit 370daf0) and built AURELIA.
Sonnet 5.5, cloud: done in 31.9 min
DeepSeek, 2 Sparks: done in 88.1 min
Tokens written, Sonnet: 194,375
Tokens written, DeepSeek: 159,465
Browser check, Sonnet: 9.0/10
Browser check, DeepSeek: 8.5/10
Cost, Sonnet: about $4.60 at API list prices (Anthropic pricing page, Oct 23, 2026), I ran it on my subscription
Cost, 2 Sparks: no API bill, my own hardware
Play the Spark world in your browser. Every number, the exact command and the raw output: https://t.co/ChVoOgfxFf
summary: 使用Claude Sonnet 5.5云端模型和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在两台DGX Sparks节点上，基于相同体素世界提示词各生成一个交互式体素世界。Sonnet模型在云端完成Skyhaven世界，耗时31.9分钟，成本约4.60美元，输出19.4万令牌，并得到了浏览器测试9.0/10分评分。DeepSeek模型在本地两Spark硬件完成AURELIA世界，耗时88.1分钟，无API成本，输出15.9万令牌，浏览器评分8.5/10。两个作品相似但不完全相同，均可在浏览器中交互体验。
summary_en: Using Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the cloud and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on two DGX Sparks, two interactive voxel worlds were generated from the same prompt. Sonnet produced the Skyhaven world in 31.9 minutes for about $4.60 with 194,375 tokens and a browser check rating of 9.0/10. DeepSeek generated the AURELIA world locally on two Sparks in 88.1 minutes with 159,465 tokens and browser rating 8.5/10. The worlds are similar but not identical, both playable in browsers.
title: Skyhaven and AURELIA Voxel Worlds via Claude Sonnet 5.5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
workflow_steps: 以同一体素世界提示词开始生成。
在云端使用Claude Sonnet 5.5生成Skyhaven世界，耗时31.9分钟。
在两台DGX Spark节点本地使用DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash与MiaAI_lab 2-Spark配方和EXL3权重生成AURELIA世界，耗时88.1分钟。
收集生成的令牌输出，评估浏览器中的交互性能和渲染质量。
比较两个世界在效果和表现上的相似度。
workflow_steps_en: Start from a common voxel-world prompt.
Run Claude Sonnet 5.5 in cloud environment to generate Skyhaven world (approx. 31.9 minutes runtime).
Run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe on two DGX Spark nodes with MiaAI_lab's 2-Spark quantized EXL3 weights to generate AURELIA world (approx. 88.1 minutes runtime).
Collect output tokens and evaluate browser-based interactivity and rendering quality.
Compare both worlds for similarity and presentation quality.

正经能拖动旋转视角、滚轮缩放、切换奇点/星云/超新星
刚用 Codex 做了个 Three.js 实时场景，从有想法到跑出这个效果，只花了 5 分钟。
不是静态图，是正经能拖动旋转视角、滚轮缩放、切换奇点/星云/超新星，还能按空格“启动跃迁”的 WebGL 实时渲染。
以前光是调这套黑洞光晕、星海粒子和整套科幻界面，怎么也得折腾半天起步。
现在用 AI 做东西最上头的感觉，就是把“脑子里闪过一个画面”到“屏幕上真的动起来”的距离，压缩到了几分钟。
summary: 访客可以拖动旋转视角、滚轮缩放、切换奇点/星云/超新星，并按空格启动跃迁的实时WebGL场景。
summary_en: Visitors interact with a real-time WebGL space scene, rotating, zooming, switching celestial views, and triggering warp effects.
title: SINGULARITY观测站
workflow_steps: 用 Codex 生成 Three.js 实时 WebGL 场景。

添加 1、2、3 键切换奇点、星云、超新星场景。
用空格键触发“跃迁”效果。
添加调节时间流速、辉光强度与渲染质量的用户控件。
部署到支持 WebGL 2.0 的网页，实现实时渲染和全屏体验。
workflow_steps_en: Use Codex to generate Three.js real-time WebGL scene.
Implement drag-to-rotate camera and mouse wheel zoom functionality.
Add scene switching among singularity, nebula, supernova using keys 1, 2, 3.
Implement space key to trigger a 'jump' effect.
Add user controls to adjust time flow, light intensity, and rendering quality.
Deploy on web supporting WebGL 2.0 for real-time rendering and full-screen experience.

evidence_quotes: Finally had some time to really try @AntSeed today.
My original plan was to use Claude Opus for the whole thing, but along the way I ran into a few longer responses timing out or stopping halfway 😅

🔹 SPACE Jump
🔹 B Boost
🔹 ↓ Slide

summary_en: This is a browser mini-game generated using AntSeed models, where the player controls a little ant running through the mossy mainframe area. The gameplay includes jumping, boosting, and sliding, controlled by space, B, and down arrow keys respectively.

切换到GPT 6 Astra模型，重新开始并成功完成游戏开发。
使用Codex比较编码体验。
在AntSeed平台上使用多模型迭代开发游戏。
workflow_steps_en: Started with Claude Opus model but encountered timeouts.
Switched to GPT 6 Astra model to rebuild game from scratch with no timeout issues.
Used Codex for coding comparison.

summary: 首日开发的太空游戏，利用GPT 5.6 Sol Ultra在12小时内生成首个可玩垂直切片。Cursor AI与Grok 4.5子代理负责飞船和视觉资产，Codex负责飞行动力学、程序化世界生成、天气及地表至空间无缝过渡。游戏具备自定义航天器、手动飞行、垂直起降和弹射发射系统、体积云和行星大气层，帧率稳定60+FPS，支持超宽屏，展现了跨越卡门线的可玩旅程。
summary_en: On Day 01 of development, the space game was created using GPT 5.6 Sol Ultra within 12 hours to produce the first playable vertical slice. Cursor AI with Grok 4.5 subagents worked on the ship and visual assets, while Codex handled flight physics, procedural world generation, weather, and seamless surface-to-space transitions. The game features custom spacecraft, manual flight, VTOL and catapult systems, volumetric clouds, planetary atmosphere, runs at 60+ FPS, supports ultrawide, and offers a playable journey beyond the Kármán line.

what makes this comparison interesting is that the scores measure different strengths

summary: 同时使用两个人工智能模型Gemini Carbon 4和Fable 5.2，在同一个3D赛车游戏环境中测试它们的表现。Gemini Carbon 4在游戏玩法评分上9.4/10，占优；Fable 5.2以9.3/10的视觉清晰度评分突出，展示了精致的赛道和流畅的画面。两者均能驾驶在同一赛道中，应对交通，使用加速道具，并进行多圈竞赛。Fable多次在比赛中取得领先位置，显示其视觉和竞争能力的优势。
summary_en: Two AI models, Gemini Carbon 4 and Fable 5.2, were tested side by side in the same 3D racing game environment. Gemini Carbon 4 achieved a higher gameplay rating of 9.4/10, while Fable 5.2 scored 9.3/10 for visual cleanliness with polished tracks and smooth gameplay. Both models navigated the same circuit, managed traffic, used boosts, and competed across multiple laps. Fable repeatedly took first place during early laps, demonstrating its visual and competitive strengths.

evidence_quotes: I gave Fable and Kimi K3 the exact same voxel world prompt and recorded whatever came out on the first try.
The prompt asked for a voxel mountain valley with a small village, a river, wandering villagers and animals, and a full day and night cycle.
Each model got one attempt with zero retries and zero edits, and the video shows both results side by side.
summary: 使用相同的体素世界提示，生成一个包含山谷、小村庄、河流、漫游的村民与动物、全天昼夜循环的体素世界。录像对比展示了两个模型首次尝试的生成结果。
summary_en: Using the same voxel world prompt, generated a voxel world featuring a mountain valley, small village, river, wandering villagers and animals, and a full day-night cycle. A video comparison shows the first-generation results of two models side by side.
title: Voxel Mountain Valley with Village and Day-Night Cycle
workflow_steps: 给两个不同的模型提供相同的体素世界提示。
要求模型生成包含山谷、小村庄、河流、漫游村民和动物以及全天昼夜循环的体素世界。
录像记录两个模型首次尝试的生成结果，无重试和编辑。
制作两个模型生成结果的并排展示视频。
邀请观众评判哪一个模型构建的体素世界更好。
workflow_steps_en: Provide an identical voxel world prompt to two different generative models simultaneously.
Request each model to generate the voxel world with specified features: mountain valley, small village, river, wandering villagers and animals, and full day-night cycle.
Record the output from each model on their first attempt without any retries or edits.
Create a side-by-side video comparing the outputs from the two models.
Invite viewers to evaluate which model produced the better voxel world.

summary: 使用 Box 平台的代理，在 10 分钟内一键生成并托管一个多玩家 3D 游戏——类似 Minecraft 的游戏。代理使用 Claude-fable-5 模型，通过 CLI 命令创建游戏，无需安装任何开发工具，支持浏览器内自动 QA 和托管，支持端口开放和 HTTPS 服务，使多人游戏可直接在线游玩。

workflow_steps_en: Install Box and start a trial.
Run 'box new --no-auto-stop' to create a persistent box for hosting and building.
Run 'box prompt --provider claude --model claude-fable-5 "make me multiplayer game xyz and host it"' to have the agent build, QA, and host the game automatically.
